title: A mine: cross-section of a machine for extracting water from the pit and three optical diagrams. Etching by T. Jefferys.
depicts: Engraved book plate (Plate CLXXX, 'facing page 2123'). Left half, 'Fig. 1. Costar's Engine for raising Water out of MINES': a tall timber frame set against dark rock, with an endless chain of buckets running up a shaft, water spouting out at the top (A) into a trough (W); at the bottom cranks/pump rods (I, K) stand in water (Z) above two pipes (M) going down into the ground. Right half (unrelated): 'Fig. 2. Mirrours' optical ray diagrams and 'Fig. 3. Mnium' (a moss). Signed 'T. Jefferys sculp'. Crop fig1_costar_engine_crop.jpg (1037x3014) keeps only Fig. 1. English, mid-18th c.: the mine-drainage problem.
